maria: Nightly perf dashboard flagged a regression — p95 latency +11% and 4% lower throughput for small-model-quant canary at 03:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.re/redwood/nightly/quant-canary\nsre-alerts: alert: p95_lat_up@canary2, kv_hit_rate_down, batching_efficiency_down :rotating_light:\njake: saw a CI perf failure on merge of PR #4821 yesterday, marked as flaky perf. Link to pipeline: https://ci/re/4821\nkevin: I started a local bisect. Preliminary result: reverting commit c3a9f2b (PR 4817) brings p95 back to baseline. That PR adjusted kernel fallback ordering + introduced seq-aware batching heuristic.
tara: do we have profiler traces? I can run perf on canary hosts now.
kevin: pasted quick flame (truncated):\n```\nhotspots:\n  run_kv_lookup  37%\n  select_kernel  22%\n  continue_batch 15%\n  kv_cache_eviction 8%\n```\nkevin: notable: select_kernel is much hotter after the change (more code paths due to fallback probing). KV miss-rate jumped ~6% causing extra roundtrips and warmup thrash.
maria: ops side — canary rollout is blocked by deploy-bot until we ack a revert. deploy-bot: rollout paused (canary 2) :no_entry_sign:
ops-bot: automated revert option available: `/deploy revert --pr 4817 --canary canary2` (requires approvals)
jake: also saw batching stats: average batch size for short requests dropped from 4.1 -> 2.7 for canary traffic. That explains throughput dip.
tara: hypothesis: seq-aware batching avoids grouping short sequences with longer ones, but fallback probing + kernel selection adds latency per request for small batches.
kevin: plan: 1) revert PR 4817 in canary, 2) run microbench: `./tools/perf_run --model small-quant --batch-sim 100k`, 3) run kernel selector trace with `RUNTIME_KS_LOG=1` for 30m, 4) gather KV eviction logs. I'll open a short PR to revert and a follow-up to split kernel fallback from batching heuristic.
maria: please tag me on the revert PR. If revert matches local, we can unpause rollout.
jake: spun up a short experiment: reverted c3a9f2b locally -> p95 back to baseline, batch size back to ~4, kv hit rate recovered.
kevin: filing postmortem notes in #incidents after we stabilize. For triage meeting at 10:30 I'll share flamegraphs and CI diffs.
maria: thanks — please include minimal repro script and command to reproduce locally so on-call can verify. :thumbsup:
